content.comment_body: Good afternoon, Is there a way to lock certain parameters, allowing only one specific parameter for the operator to change? For instance, I want the operator to be able to adjust the temperature on the display, but not modify any other parameters. Thank you. [user_name]

There are several approaches for this. One option is to display only the parameters you want to be adjustable in a particular message, which can be accessed only after entering a correct password (for example, a 6-digit code between 000000 and 999999). Are you familiar with switching between operator mode and admin mode?
I'm not sure how to switch between operator mode and admin mode. Is there also a way to set a maximum input value for a parameter?

In admin mode, all menu options are accessible. In operator mode, access is restricted; for example, the option to switch the device to STOP or change the IP address is not available. Changing to admin mode requires a password, with a default value that can be customized.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to control access to device parameters so that only authorized individuals can change sensitive settings, while operators are permitted to adjust specific values. There is uncertainty regarding role management (operator versus admin) and parameter protection, suggesting the need for more user-friendly guidance on switching roles and setting up access restrictions and password protection.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to restrict parameters, allowing operator-level access only to chosen ones, as well as options for setting maximum values for inputs.
